game_title: Pattern Painter – Fairy Ring Glade Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the fairy lantern.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the fairy lantern. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 5 consecutive correct decisions about pattern_rows to power up the herbalist and open the fairy lantern.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Fairy Ring Glade'.
